A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Duros''' [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] accompanied the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] in an [[Ambush in Cloud City|ambush]] set up for [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Dominic Raynor]], owner of Cloud City, the primary [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], lost the ownership of the floating [[City/Legends|city]] to the professional [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] Calrissian. Raynor accused his opponent of cheating and hired Bossk to get Calrissian [[Death/Legends|dead]] or alive. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter brought some [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]], including the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], to Cloud City, where they planned a trap for the new [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]]. The plan was to lure Calrissian to a lower maintenance level of the city with the help of a fake emergency call. Down there, the Duros and his companions ambushed the Baron's party, but Calrissian fled through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]<ref name="SWM" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="date">The ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'' scenario does not provide a time frame for Bossk's ambush, in which the Duros was present, but the comic [[Lady Luck (comic story)|''Lady Luck'']] states that Calrissian won Cloud City in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Furthermore, the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'', which describes Raynor's last assassination attempt against Calrissian happening around six weeks after the sabacc match, reveals that the ambush happens within these six weeks.</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Dominic Raynor]], [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the floating [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], lost his [[City/Legends|city]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] against a professional player, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Raynor, believing that Calrissian had cheated, hired the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to capture the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Death/Legends|dead]] or alive. Bossk knew that Calrissian, the new [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]], would be well protected, so he brought along some mercenaries and [[Assassin/Legends|cutthroats]], including the Duros, a [[Unidentified Twi'lek 1 (Ambush in Cloud City)|Twi'lek scoundrel]], [[Unidentified Twi'lek 2 (Ambush in Cloud City)|another Twi'lek]] of the same profession, and a [[Unidentified Quarren (Ambush in Cloud City)|Quarren assassin]]. The Trandoshan hoped that his team could deal with any problems that might arise during the hunt.<ref name="SLR" />

The Duros and his companions slipped through the security of Cloud City and set up a [[Ambush in Cloud City|trap]] to capture Calrissian in a lower maintenance level of the city. Bossk lured the Baron Administrator into the trap by alerting him in the name of the [[Cloud City chief engineer|city's chief engineer]]. The Trandoshan sent a fake emergency call through the city's communication system and reported to Calrissian that a primary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pod of the city would break down and destroy the floating settlement. In response, Calrissian went to the maintenance level; however, he took his [[Unidentified Twi'lek bodyguard|Twi'lek bodyguard]] and four [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guards]] along as a precautionary measure.<ref name="SLR" />

Bossk was unsure of which [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] Calrissian would arrive in, so he ordered the Duros and the others to spread into every room near the lifts. The Trandoshan also ordered the members of the team to lure Calrissian out by remaining in sight, while Bossk was hiding and waiting for the right moment to attack. When Calrissian's group entered the maintenance level, a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] suddenly shut behind them, and the Duros and his companions opened [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire on Calrissian's escorts, who decided to hold their enemies off while the Baron Administrator escaped through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. However, a member of Calrissian's party sent a distress call to another quartet of Wing Guards. After the reinforcements had arrived, the Baron Administrator managed to flee the ambush through the hangar.<ref name="SLR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DurosMercenary-SWM.jpg|thumb|right|100px|The Duros mercenary's figurine]]
The Duros appeared in ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'', a [[Wizards.com]] online scenario written by [[Eric Cagle]] for the ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' collectible tabletop strategy game in [[2004]]. During the game, one player controls Calrissian's party, and another controls Bossk's party, including the Duros, who is represented by a generic Duros Mercenary miniature figurine<ref name="SLR" /> from the ''Miniatures'' set [[Rebel Storm (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Rebel Storm'']].<ref name="SWM" /> The survival of the character depends on the players' actions.<ref name="SLR" />
